name: i2v-ai
description: Official i2v.ai MCP server for image generation and text-to-video or image-to-video across 12 image and 16 video models, with a USD quote before every paid task and a caller-set spending ceiling.

I2V_API_KEY.description: i2v.ai API key for local stdio or bearer authentication. Create one at https://i2v.ai/dashboard/api-keys. Generation uses account credits.

http.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 (PKCE, mcp:read / mcp:write). Every paid task returns a USD quote first and accepts a caller-set maxCostUsd ceiling.

http-api-key.description: Hosted Streamable HTTP using a caller-owned i2v.ai API key instead of OAuth.

npm.description: Local stdio server. Requires Node.js 20+ and an i2v.ai API key.
